name: Suspicious SSH Logins — Beginner Walkthrough
description: A simple, visual walkthrough: a server reports repeated failed logins, the AI proposes a response, and an independent Referee checks that response before the simulated incident is closed.

initialContext.incident: A server received 25 unsuccessful SSH sign-in attempts within 2 minutes.
initialContext.notes: All IPs, users and security actions are simulated. 203.0.113.25 is a documentation-only example address.

nodes.label: 1. Alert arrives
nodes.description: The system detects many failed SSH logins.

nodes.label: 2. Collect facts
nodes.description: Read the source address, affected server and failed-login count.
nodes.plainLanguage: What happened, where and how often?

nodes.label: 3. Check source
nodes.description: Determine whether the source is external or is a protected internal asset.
nodes.plainLanguage: Is it safe to block this address?

nodes.label: 4A. Propose IP block
nodes.description: AI proposes a simulated perimeter block for an external suspicious source.
nodes.plainLanguage: AI suggests blocking the outside address.

nodes.label: 4B. Escalate to SOC
nodes.description: AI proposes notifying a security analyst rather than blocking a protected internal source.
nodes.plainLanguage: Ask a human security analyst to review it.

nodes.label: 5. Referee checks
nodes.description: A deterministic policy checker approves or rejects the proposed action.
nodes.plainLanguage: Is the AI's suggestion allowed by the rules?

nodes.label: 6A. Apply simulated response
nodes.description: Record the approved response in the scenario state. No real firewall or server is changed.

nodes.label: 7. Save audit trail
nodes.description: Record the proposed decision, Referee verdict, state changes and timestamps.
nodes.plainLanguage: Write down what happened and why.

nodes.label: 8. Show results
nodes.description: Present the completed simulation, evaluated decisions and applicable rule adherence.

nodes.label: 6B. Review rejected action
nodes.description: Do not apply a rejected action. Record the violation and route it for manual review.
nodes.plainLanguage: The AI suggestion broke a rule; stop that action.

illustrativeWalkthrough.exampleRefereeDecision: APPROVED if the external-address block satisfies the installed demo policy
illustrativeWalkthrough.whatToWatch: Follow the highlighted node from alert to investigation, then the branch at N-03, the independent check at N-06, and the final report at N-09.
